# Provenance (read-only, 2026-10-28):
# - Laputa xinit service: laputa/packages/mdevd/service.xsh
# - Laputa qemu-dwl-foot boot hook: laputa/profiles/qemu-dwl-foot/usr/lib/init/rc.d/laputa-qemu-dwl-foot.boot
# Canonical daemon invocation under test:
#   mdevd -O 4 -f /etc/mdev.conf -C
# with PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin, restart always.
# Serial coldplug step after daemon start:
#   mdevd-coldplug -O 4
# Proves: the exact Laputa argv shape must be accepted with identical semantics.
# Does not prove: guest-boot end-to-end (needs a KVM guest; see docs/testing.md).
mdevd -O 4 -f /etc/mdev.conf -C
mdevd-coldplug -O 4
